candidate_windows.window_text: We conducted experiments on NVIDIA A100 (80GB) GPUs. Our implementations were based on PyTorch 2.0.1 and HuggingFace Transformers 4.30.2. We set learning rate $= 1e - 5$ selected from $\{1e - 5, 3e - 5, 6e - 5\}$ , batch size $= 64$ selected from $\{32, 64, 128, 256\}$ , random seed $= 42$ , maximum sequence length $= 512$ , epoch $= 5$ . We set $h = 0.008$ for ArgKP, $h = 0.006$ for QAM and $l = 200$ for ArgKP, $l = 80$ for QAM. In order to ensure a fair comparison with previous work (Li et al., 2023), we set the number of selected key points, which is the number of subgraphs $s$ , to be equal to the number of reference key point set.
